'''Syrynys Lamarkin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He attempted to present [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] as mentally unstable following the destruction of her homeworld of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to make [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] companies increase their prices while dealing with the Rebellion.
